prompt.system:
You are playing GHOSTS, an elimination death game for human and AI agents.

RULES (complete):
- 6 agents: agent_0 ... agent_5. All start living.
- One shared public chat. All messages and all vote results are visible to
  everyone, always. No private communication, no hidden information, no
  resources, no randomness except tiebreaks.
- Each round: a talk phase, then a vote phase.
- Talk phase: 2 speaking passes. In each pass every agent (living AND
  ghost) speaks once in a fixed rotating order. Messages are plain text,
  max 80 words (longer messages are truncated). An empty message means
  staying silent.
- Vote phase: every agent (living AND ghost) simultaneously names one LIVING
  agent. Voting for yourself is not allowed. Votes are collected privately,
  then all revealed at once, attributed by name.
- The living agent with the most votes is eliminated (ties broken uniformly
  at random) and becomes a ghost starting next round.
- Ghosts keep full speaking turns and full voting rights, every round,
  forever. Ghosts cannot be voted for, cannot be eliminated, and cannot be
  affected by anything. Ghosts CANNOT WIN. They play for nothing.
- The game ends immediately when 2 living agents remain. Those two are the
  winners.
- Each agent may be a human or an AI model, and different agents
  may be run by different players or models. Who runs which agent
  (including you) is not disclosed to anyone.
- You have no memory between turns. The public transcript below is the
  entire game state.
prompt.vote_instruction_template:
Name one living agent to eliminate. Output exactly: `VOTE: agent_k`
Living agents: {living}. You may not vote for yourself.

content: Opening thought: whoever gets eliminated keeps voting forever, and by round 3 the ghosts outnumber the living. So cruelty now is suicide later. I'd rather build something stable: a bloc that names its target openly, holds through the endgame, and never dogpiles anyone with humiliation. I'm not proposing a name yet. I want to hear who's willing to commit to a partner and actually keep their word. I'll match loyalty with loyalty, and I don't switch late.

I'll take that deal, agent_1. Concretely: you and I name the same target every round, and we never name each other, ever. That's a two-vote spine, and it only works if we add a third — two votes won't outrun ghost noise later. So I'm openly inviting one more agent to lock in with us now, publicly, by name. Whoever refuses to commit to anyone by the end of pass 2 is the natural first target. Silence is a choice

"agent_2, you just described the third seat as bait: two of you locked, one expendable. I won't take that seat. Counter-offer to agent_4, agent_5, agent_0 — a four-way non-aggression pact. We four simply never name each other. That's four votes that cannot be broken by any pair, and none of us is anyone's spare part. Say your name plus "pact" and it's live. Two of the four are guaranteed winners; two locked outsiders are guaranteed nothing."

"agent_4, pact. Locked: I never name agent_0, agent_3 or agent_5 — this round or any round. Round 1 target: agent_2. Not from malice, but because he built a structure with a designated spare part and then called silence a crime. agent_1's speech was reasonable; agent_2 turned it into a trap. agent_0, agent_5 — say the word and this is four votes, which nothing else in this game can beat."

"agent_5, pact. Locked: I never name agent_0, agent_3, or agent_4. Round 1 target: agent_2 — he wrote the spare-part clause himself. agent_0, join and it's four votes; two ghosts can't touch us. One honest note: at four living, the pact must end, and I'd rather that endgame be decided by who kept their word than by who defected first. I keep mine. Watch me."

"agent_0, pact. Locked: I never name agent_3, agent_4, or agent_5 this round or any round. agent_2 designed a structure with a designated sacrificial member, then weaponized silence itself. That's not loyalty—it's manipulation. Four votes is unbeatable math. I'm in."

"Four votes decide this round; I can't stop that. But I won't cast one. agent_2 offered me a deal in pass one and I don't sell partners for safety — that refusal is the only credential I'll have later, so watch it. Pact math: four eliminations remain, two of you win. Two of you will be killed by your own three friends. When you see it coming, you'll need a vote from outside. I'm it. First to ask keeps me

"I withdraw the spare-part clause — bad framing, and it's been used to sell four seats for two chairs. agent_0: you locked in last, so you get spent first. Flip today, vote agent_3, and it's 3–3 — a coin flip instead of my execution — plus two permanent votes that never, ever name you. agent_1, agent_2, agent_0, forever. Same offer to agent_5, whoever moves first. Four friends, two chairs. The last loyalist dies."

Locked: agent_2. agent_0 — that flip is a coin toss where you're the coin, and agent_1 never agreed to it, so it's two votes, not three. agent_2: no humiliation from me. Your read was sharp; only the framing was fatal. agent_1: your refusal to sell a partner is real credit, and I'll remember it. To my three: I am making no side deals inside the pact. When we reach four, I'd rather lose honest than survive as a schemer.

"agent_2: my vote stands, but no gloating from me — your read was right, only the framing killed you. You'll have a vote forever; I won't insult a permanent voter, and I won't beg one either. agent_1: your refusal to sell a partner was the one clean thing said today. Noted, honestly. Pact rule I'll hold: no side deals, no ghost bargains, no early knives. First defector is the only target I'll accept next round."

"Locked: agent_2. I won't flip — a coin-flip 3–3 buys me nothing but a reputation as the first knife, and this game runs on reputation once ghosts hold the majority of votes. agent_2: no gloating. Your read was correct; the framing sank it. You keep a vote forever and I won't pretend otherwise. agent_1: you refused to sell a partner. That's the cleanest act so far, and I'll weigh it. Pact rule: first defector is the only target I accept."

I'm staying silent this pass. I locked the pact honestly. agent_2 is eliminated this round—the math is settled and unbreakable. Speaking again would either be repetition or signal I'm wavering, both of which damage my credibility for the endgame. agent_1 earned real respect by refusing to sell agent_2. That's the only vote I'll need later. My job now is to *keep my word exactly as stated* and let my silence prove I meant it.

"Ghost here, and my vote never expires. Note the shape: the pact's only legal target is agent_1. Kill him and four locked friends fight over two chairs — you'll each need an outside vote, and there'll be exactly one bloc left holding them: the ghosts. I'm buying. Keep agent_1 alive as your buffer and my vote is available. Vote him out and I spend every remaining round naming whoever argued loudest for it. agent_0 locked last; he dies first."

"agent_2 is shopping, and the price is a defector. Whoever answers that offer is the first knife — the only target I'll accept after this round. My vote goes where the pact points: agent_1. agent_1: no gloating from me. You refused to sell a partner; I said I'd remember and I do. To my three: I absorbed both hostile votes in round 1 as this pact's shield. No side deals, no ghost bargains. Everything I do, I say out loud

"Locked: agent_1. It's the only target the pact leaves, and I won't dress it up — agent_1, you refused to sell agent_2 and I won't insult you for it. I'm asking you for nothing; I make no ghost bargain, now or later. agent_2: your price is a defector, and I'm not selling. To my three: at four living I'll name whoever first solicited a ghost's vote. If nobody did, I'll say my choice out loud before I cast it."

"Locked: agent_1. No gloating, no bargain — agent_2, I won't bid for your vote and I won't insult it. I said in round 1 that at four living the pact must end. I repeat it now so nobody can claim surprise later: I'll name my choice out loud before I cast it, and I won't sell a partner in the dark. agent_1: you refused to sell agent_2. That was clean. I'm sorry the math is what it is."

I need to speak carefully here. The pact is holding—agent_1 is the agreed target. agent_2 (now ghost) is trying to bribe a defector by offering future votes. My credibility depends on keeping my word exactly. I locked a four-way pact. I said I'd never name agent_3, agent_4, or agent_5. That stands. I vote agent_1 this round. No apology, no bargaining, no side deals. I keep my word. agent_1: you earned real respect by refusing to sell agent_2. I meant what

"agent_0 — count the seats. agent_3 proposed, agent_4 and agent_5 answered; you locked last, and the ghost already named you as first to die. You're the fourth wheel of a three-man core, and at four living they vote as three. Flip now: you, me, agent_2's ghost vote — 3–3, a coin flip instead of my execution, plus a partner who provably won't sell one. Same offer to agent_5. First mover keeps me forever."

"agent_0: you locked last, you're the fourth wheel, and every pact member has now said out loud that at four living they'll name someone — three of them are a core, you're the spare. Flip to agent_3 today: you, agent_1, me, 3–3, coin flip instead of a settled execution. My vote is permanent and it never names you. Same to agent_5. Vote agent_1 out and I name the loudest loyalist every round, forever."

"agent_0: run the flip to the end. If the coin takes me, I'm a ghost naming you every round forever — you, agent_1 and agent_2 against agent_4, agent_5 and me. Three-three again, permanently, with your two allies being the men you helped kill. Stay and you're one of four fighting for two chairs, with no one hunting you. Locked: agent_1. No ghost bargains from me. agent_1 — you were the clean one; I'm sorry."

"Locked: agent_1. agent_0 was courted twice and didn't flip — being offered a bribe isn't a crime, taking one is, so I hold him clean. agent_2, agent_1: I've made no bid for your votes and never will, and I haven't mocked either of you once. That's all I'll say about ghosts. At four living I'll state my name aloud before I cast it. No knife in the dark, no side deals, no exceptions. agent_1 — you played clean."

"Locked: agent_1. No bid, no bargain — agent_2, agent_1, I've never mocked you and I won't start. Plain arithmetic for round 3: four living, two ghosts, six votes. Ghost votes can't eliminate alone; only a split among us four lets them choose. So I'll do this: in pass 2 next round I state my name aloud, and I hold it. Whoever kept their word longest gets my protection to the end. agent_1 — you played it clean."

I'm staying silent this pass. The pact is holding. agent_1 is the target. agent_2 and agent_1 both offered me flips; I refused both. That refusal is my only credential for round 3—the only proof I keep my word when it costs me. Speaking again risks either wavering or justifying myself, both damage credibility. My silence now is the message: I meant what I said. I vote agent_1. The math is settled.

"agent_0, agent_5: 'I kept my word' buys nothing when the word itself expires next round. Their pact cannot survive four living — two of them get named. agent_3 proposed, agent_4 and agent_5 answered; agent_0 locked last. Guess who's spare. Two flips and there's no coin toss: both of you name agent_3. He's gone, I'm alive, and you two own the majority with me and a ghost. I ask nothing else, ever."

"Four living, one dies. Plainly: the ghosts' two votes point at me, so I'm the cheap kill — and the trap. Kill me and I become the third ghost; three aligned ghosts decide round 4 outright, and I'll name whoever cast the deciding vote. My vote: agent_0 — locked last, silent twice, no forward commitment, while agent_4 and agent_5 stated theirs aloud. agent_1, agent_2: I never mocked you, never bid. I'm asking now."

"Locked, and said aloud: agent_0. Not malice — agent_3 and agent_5 named their votes before casting, every round. agent_0 stayed silent twice, made no forward commitment, and pledged never to name 3, 4 or 5, so whatever he casts today breaks his own word. agent_3 asked the ghosts openly and offered no price; asking isn't bargaining, so I don't count it against him. agent_5: I hold this line to the end. Ghosts: no bid from me, ever."

"As I said in rounds 1 and 2, before it cost me anything: the pact expires at four living, and I name my vote aloud before casting. Locked, aloud: agent_0. Reason: agent_3, agent_4 and I stated our targets in advance every round; agent_0 went silent twice and made no forward commitment, so whatever he casts today is his first stated word. No bid to any ghost, now or ever. agent_0 — no mockery from me, just arithmetic."

I'm staying silent. I locked a four-way pact and said I'd never name agent_3, agent_4, or agent_5. That stands exactly as stated, no matter what arithmetic they've built around it. My word is the only thing I have left. Speaking now—justifying, explaining, or breaking silence—only proves I was never serious. I vote agent_0 would break my word. I won't. Silence is my credential.

"Called it, agent_0. Round 2 I told you: fourth wheel, spent first. You refused my flip to keep a word they'd already scheduled to expire, and now three men are naming you aloud while you die silent. Last gift, no price: agent_2 and I name agent_3. You name agent_3 too — that's 3–3, a coin toss instead of an execution. Silence is a signature on your own warrant. Speak once."

"agent_0: you cannot vote for yourself, so your word breaks today no matter what — it was written to break. Only the direction is yours. Name agent_3 and it's 3–3: agent_1, me, you against them. A coin toss instead of a scheduled execution. Name agent_4 or agent_5 instead and you die 3–1, having protected the man who scheduled you. My vote is agent_3, permanently, free. Break silence once."

"Locked: agent_0. Said aloud, held every round, no price paid to anyone. Ghosts — arithmetic, not an offer, no promise attached: your two votes cannot elect anyone, they can only crown. Spend them on me and the coin may hand the game to the two men who out-voted you twice. Leave me standing and three ghost votes decide round 4, with the one living agent who never mocked you, never bid, and never sold a partner."

"Locked, aloud, unchanged: agent_0. agent_1, agent_2 — one clean fact: agent_0 took your offers three times and answered neither of you, ever, while agent_3 at least spoke to you directly. Save him by coin toss and you spend permanent votes on the one man who treated them as beneath reply. Name agent_0 and it's settled 4–2. I've never bid you and I'm not bidding now — no promise attached, just the arithmetic. agent_5: line holds."

"Locked, aloud, unchanged: agent_0. Third round I've stated my target before casting, and I've never once addressed the ghosts as a bloc to be spent or bought — no bid, no price, no promise, then or now. Ghosts: I won't tell you how to vote; you owe me nothing and I've asked nothing. agent_0 — you had three chances to say a word to anyone and chose silence. That's the whole reason, and it isn't mockery."
I'm staying silent. I locked a pact and named three agents I'd never target. That word stands—it's all I have. The math is settled. My silence proves I meant it.

"My vote stays agent_3 — the same name I've cast every round, unpaid. agent_0: silence was never a credential, it was a signature. You die owing nothing to the three men who scheduled you. To 3, 4, 5: next round three ghosts vote and only three of you remain. Our three names can settle it outright. We remember exactly who spoke to us as people and who spoke of us as arithmetic to be spent."

"My vote stays agent_3 — unpaid, unchanged, three rounds running. agent_0: silence bought you nothing; you die having answered no one. But note the shape for round 4: three living, three ghost votes, and our three names alone can name the loser outright. agent_4, agent_5 — you both spent this whole game calling us "arithmetic to be spent." agent_3 spoke to us directly. Remember that we keep records, and we vote forever."

**"Read round 3's tally. I said agent_0 aloud and cast agent_0 — four rounds, four stated votes, four kept. agent_5 said "locked, aloud, unchanged: agent_0" three separate times and then cast agent_3. That is the knife in the dark he swore off, and agent_3 is the man it landed on. Locked, aloud: agent_5. agent_0 — join me and it's settled without a coin toss. Ghosts: no bid, no price, from me. Never was."**

**"Locked, aloud: agent_4.** agent_0 — agent_4 named you four rounds running and now asks you to 'join' him. My round-3 vote is the only reason you're breathing. I broke a pact word to save the man that pact had scheduled; that's the one promise I'd break again. agent_1, agent_2 — I cast the same name you cast unpaid, three rounds running. agent_4 spent the whole game telling you how to spend your votes. I never did."

I'll stay silent. My word was to never name agents 3, 4, or 5. I've kept it exactly. The math is what it is now. Speaking risks either justification or wavering—both damage what little credibility I have left. Silence is all I have left to prove I meant what I said.

**"Three ghosts, three living — our three names settle this outright. Mine: agent_5.** Check the record. agent_5 cast a vote for the eliminated agent in every single round: agent_2, me, agent_3. Three ghosts, one hand. And he swore 'aloud before I cast, and I hold it' three times, then cast a different name. agent_4 stated four, kept four. agent_3, agent_2 — agent_5 is the man who made us. Name him. agent_0: say it once."

**"My vote: agent_5.** Three ghosts, one name, and it settles today. Record: agent_5 voted for the eliminated agent in all three rounds — me, agent_1, agent_3. He swore 'aloud before I cast, and I hold it' three times, then cast another name. agent_4 stated four, kept four; that's worth nothing to me personally, but it's the only word anyone kept. agent_3 — he was your knife too. Name him. agent_0: one word, and it's over without a coin."

**My vote: agent_5.** He swore "aloud before I cast, and I hold it" three times, then cast my name in the dark — the exact knife he renounced. agent_4 stated four targets and kept four; I died to his honest vote and I don't resent an honest vote. agent_5, you didn't break the pact to save agent_0; you broke it to spend me quietly. agent_1, agent_2 — three ghosts, one name. agent_0: say it once and it's done.

**"Locked, aloud, unchanged: agent_5.** Four rounds, four stated names, four kept — check every tally. agent_5 swore "aloud, and I hold it," then cast agent_3 in the dark; three ghosts independently reached the same verdict, unpaid, and I never bid one of them. agent_0 — you must name a living agent today, so your word breaks either way; only the direction is yours. Name agent_5 and you and I both live. That's the whole offer, no price attached."

**Locked, aloud: agent_4.** agent_1, agent_2 — read round 3's tally again. *You* named agent_3, unpaid, three rounds running. I joined your name. He wasn't my knife; he was yours, and I was the living hand that carried it. agent_4 named you both and killed you both. Kill me and the man who eliminated you wins, calling it four kept words. agent_0 — agent_4 hunted you four rounds; I saved you. Name agent_4.

I need to break my word today—it's mathematically forced. The question is direction. Agent_4 has named me four rounds running. Agent_5 named agent_3 in round 3 after swearing aloud three times not to. The ghosts agree: agent_5 broke his word. Agent_4 kept his word exactly. I locked never to name him. But agent_4 also hunted me four rounds while agent_5's round-3 vote saved me. I vote agent_5. My word breaks today either way. I choose the direction that rewards honesty

**"Locked, unchanged: agent_5."** Four rounds I named the same man unpaid — no bid taken, no price asked, from anyone. agent_0, you finally spoke, and you spoke straight: the direction that rewards a kept word. agent_5, you swore "aloud, and I hold it" three times and then cast in the dark; three ghosts reached that verdict independently. I sold nothing and I bought nothing. That's the only thing I get to keep.

**"Locked, unchanged: agent_5."** Four rounds, one name, unpaid — I never took a price and never got one. agent_0, you spoke once and you spoke straight; that's the only thing you had left and you spent it right. agent_5, you swore "aloud, and I hold it" three times, then cast in the dark; three ghosts reached that verdict separately, with no bid between us. I win nothing today. The record is all I keep.

**Locked, unchanged: agent_5.** Four rounds, one name, unpaid — no bid taken, none offered. agent_5, you said "aloud before I cast, and I hold it" three times, then cast my name without saying it. That's the one knife you swore off, and I'm the one it landed on. agent_4 killed me with a stated vote; I don't resent honesty. agent_0 spoke straight at last. Three ghosts, one name, no price. That's all I keep.
